scripts.dev: pnpm db:generate && pnpm --filter @map-chat/contracts build && node scripts/check-test-services.mjs && concurrently -k -n api,web "PORT=${PORT:-4000} DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://mapchat_test:mapchat_test@127.0.0.1:55431/mapchat_foundation_test} REDIS_URL=${REDIS_URL:-redis://127.0.0.1:56381} READINESS_TIMEOUT_MS=${READINESS_TIMEOUT_MS:-1000} BETTER_AUTH_SECRET=${BETTER_AUTH_SECRET:-local-only-dummy-auth-secret-change-before-deployment-2026} BETTER_AUTH_URL=${BETTER_AUTH_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:${WEB_PORT:-3000}} BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS=${BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS:-http://127.0.0.1:${WEB_PORT:-3000}} GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=${GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID:-dummy-google-client-id} GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=${GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET:-dummy-google-client-secret} pnpm --filter @map-chat/api dev" "DEV_API_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:${PORT:-4000} WEB_PORT=${WEB_PORT:-3000} pnpm --filter @map-chat/web dev"
scripts.services:test:up: docker compose -f compose.test.yaml up -d --wait && pnpm db:migrate:test:deploy
scripts.typecheck: pnpm db:generate && pnpm --filter @map-chat/contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @map-chat/contracts build && pnpm --filter @map-chat/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @map-chat/web typecheck
scripts.test:api:integration: node scripts/check-test-services.mjs && pnpm db:generate && pnpm db:migrate:test:deploy && TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://mapchat_test:mapchat_test@127.0.0.1:55431/mapchat_foundation_test TEST_REDIS_URL=redis://127.0.0.1:56381 TEST_REDIS_KEY_PREFIX=foundation:task001:local: pnpm --filter @map-chat/api test:integration
scripts.build: pnpm db:generate && pnpm --filter @map-chat/contracts build && pnpm --filter @map-chat/api build && pnpm --filter @map-chat/web build
